note: Provincial park on the south shore of Greenwater Lake, 36 km N of Kelvington on Hwy 38. Five forested campgrounds: Poplar Ridge has the full-service sites; Cranberry, Hilltop, Lakeshore and Aspen Grove are electric. Aspen Grove's sites and Lakeshore L22, L32 and L34 take 18 ft at most. 51 sites are seasonal. Also two yurts and six hike-in sites at Jug and Marean lakes. --Claude
